name: Qatar Airways
verdict: Wholly owned by the government of Qatar.

why.text: Qatar Airways is fully owned by the government of Qatar. In the years before the 2022 World Cup, migrant workers in Qatar faced widespread abuses, including unpaid wages, recruitment fees and deaths, and Amnesty International and Human Rights Watch report that workers still faced exploitation under the kafala system in 2025. A famous shirt makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That’s called sportswashing.
why.messageLine: Migrant workers in Qatar still faced labour abuses and exploitation under the kafala system in 2025.
